paper.title_en: Exploring M-theory on AdS$_7\times$S$^4$: Mellin amplitudes with composite operators
paper.abstract_en: We bootstrap mixed correlators in M-theory on AdS$_7\times$S$^4$, focusing on tree-level correlation functions involving one double-particle operator and three single-particle operators. Combining inputs from AdS/CFT, the chiral algebra, and the OPE at large central charge, we uniquely determine the Mellin amplitude for $\langle [{\cal O}_{2}{\cal O}_{q}]{\cal O}_{2}{\cal O}_{p}{\cal O}_{p+q-2}\rangle$ for generic $p$ and $q$. While our main focus is the $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ SCFT in six dimensions, we also derive the analogous result in AdS$_5\times$S$^5$, applying the same bootstrap approach to $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM. Despite their different dynamics, the resulting Mellin amplitudes exhibit a strikingly similar structure, with non-trivial OPE predictions for low-twist protected operators providing a key input. Our work is motivated by recent developments in the study of Kaluza-Klein correlators in bubbling geometries, where four-point functions involving single- and multi-particle operators are computed as response functions to smooth deformations of the vacuum geometry. While well tested in AdS$_5\times$S$^5$, we aim to extend this framework to M-theory.
